description: When a session starts, refresh the project's sly files if the plugin is newer. Before Claude finishes, run the sly drift check. Works in Claude Code and Codex.

hooks.command: d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; [ -d "$d/.sly" ] || exit 0; command -v python3 >/dev/null || exit 0; python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/install.py" "$d" --auto || true
f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}/.sly/check.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; command -v python3 >/dev/null || exit 0; exec python3 "$f" --hook
